android.desc:
Note: The app works offline.  Very safe to use.

Take control of your finances with Munim, the all-in-one personal finance and expense tracking app! Whether you're managing daily expenses, tracking income, creating budgets, or overseeing your business transactions, Munim is the perfect tool to simplify your financial life.

NOTE: The app will work offline as well because the app does not share SMS data with third parties. 

Key Features:
1. Expense Tracker
Easily record and categorize your expenses. Munim allows you to log your daily expenses and income, helping you stay on top of your financial health.

2. Budget Management
Set custom budgets for different categories such as food, transportation, entertainment, and more. Munim will help you monitor your spending and alert you when you're nearing your budget limits.

3. Financial Reports
Generate detailed reports on your income, expenses, and savings. Munim offers easy-to-read pie charts, bar graphs, and monthly summaries that give you a clear picture of your financial habits.

4. Secure and Private
Your financial data is important. Munim will not share the data with a third party. It can run offline. 

5. Expense Categories
Organize your spending with customizable categories such as groceries, utilities, shopping, and more. This helps you easily visualize where your money is going and make smarter financial decisions.

8. Search and Filter
Easily search and filter your transactions by date, category, or amount. Find any transaction in seconds with our powerful search tool.

Why Choose Munim?
User-friendly Interface: Munim is designed with simplicity and ease of use in mind. Whether you're new to financial management or a seasoned expert, Munim's intuitive design will make tracking your finances effortless.
No Ads, No Distractions: Enjoy an ad-free experience that allows you to focus on what matters most — managing your money.
Lightweight & Fast: Munim is optimized for speed and performance, ensuring it runs smoothly even on older devices.
Who is Munim for?
Individuals who want to track personal expenses and savings.
Freelancers who need to manage client payments and project budgets.
Small Business Owners looking to manage daily expenses, business accounts, and cash flow.
Students wanting to control their spending and save money.
With Munim, you’re just a few taps away from achieving financial clarity and peace of mind.
